❯ Without using any tools, write three short numbered lines about tmux, then a closing sentence.

● Here are three lines about tmux:

  1. tmux is a terminal multiplexer that runs several shell sessions inside one terminal window.
  2. Its sessions keep running after you detach, so you can reconnect later, even over SSH.
  3. You can split windows into panes and switch between them with a prefix key, Ctrl-b by default.

  Once you learn a few key bindings, tmux becomes hard to work without.
